title: Published completed open factor with induced quasi-compactness
statement: Let $A$ have adic datum $d$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be quasi-compact, and choose compactifications $c=(j,p)$ of $f$ and $c'=(j',p')$ of $f':X'\to Y'$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], an arrow $\bar g:\overline X'\to\overline X$, and an open Cartesian square $(g',j',j,\bar g)$ [def-cbc-open-immersion-square]. Given a finite generating tuple $a$ for the adic ideal and $K$ in the corresponding derived-complete full subcategory [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map], define cbcRealizationOpenFactor to be the component at $K$ of the canonical completed open exchange [lem-cbc-completed-extension-zero-comparison]. Use precisely the quasi-compactness of $j$ induced from $c$ and quasi-compactness of $f$. This is an abbreviation for that existing map and asserts no realization or normalization equation.
